claims.allowed_public_wording: Relaytic-AML includes a local release-freeze pack that records benchmark relevance, reproducibility posture, and blocked claims.
claims.claim_text: Relaytic-AML emits a reproducible local paper/release freeze pack with explicit claim gates.
claims.rationale: This is a product-surface claim about artifacts generated by the repository, not a model-performance claim.

claims.allowed_public_wording: PaySim-style evidence is a relevant proxy/dev workflow, not a hard real-world AML superiority result.
claims.claim_text: Relaytic-AML can run a PaySim-style temporal transaction-fraud workflow and emit AML temporal/environment gates.
claims.rationale: The workflow shape is covered, but synthetic/proxy source posture blocks hard claims.

claims.allowed_public_wording: Flattened Elliptic-style evidence is supporting proxy graph AML evidence until raw graph/holdout gates pass.
claims.claim_text: Relaytic-AML can run flattened Elliptic-style graph AML evidence and expose graph claim-scope artifacts.
claims.rationale: Flattened graph compatibility is useful but not a raw graph paper claim.

claims.allowed_public_wording: Hard AML performance claims are blocked until a frozen holdout/paper track reports numeric evidence and all claim gates pass.
claims.claim_text: Relaytic-AML is a SOTA or hard public AML benchmark winner.
claims.rationale: The current freeze pack records the absence of hard numeric holdout evidence rather than manufacturing a leaderboard claim.

claims.allowed_public_wording: Generic structured-data benchmark evidence is supporting breadth context and is not the flagship AML proof.
claims.claim_text: Relaytic has generic structured-data benchmark evidence that can support the AML story as breadth context.
claims.rationale: Generic tabular results are useful context but cannot replace AML temporal, graph, and operational evidence.

claims.allowed_public_wording: Subgraph and synthetic-bank graph tracks are cataloged and blocked until data access, loader support, and reproducible generation are frozen.
claims.claim_text: Relaytic-AML has paper-ready subgraph AML or AMLSim-style synthetic-bank graph evidence.
claims.rationale: Relevant future tracks are named, but substitution with weaker evidence is explicitly disallowed.
